title: security: rbac v2 - enforce KMS region pinning & audit logging hardening
author: Asha Patel
description: Summary: Enforce KMS region pinning in RBAC v2 policies by default and harden audit logging for KMS and residency-sensitive operations. Motivation: customers in regulated jurisdictions require provable data residency and KMS residency controls; we observed gaps where fallback keys could be used in other regions and audit entries lacked key-residency context. This PR: - Adds enforcement toggle (opt-in via org policy) to require KMS region pinning at policy evaluation time. - Adds explicit KMS key residency attributes to audit log payloads and enriches existing audit messages with region and key_id. - Updates rbac policy evaluation to reject cross-region key usage when enforce flag is set. - Adds migration utility to surface orgs currently violating residency rules. - Adds integration tests and E2E test harness in perf-canary for policy evaluation under load. Backwards compatibility: default is audit-mode (log-only) for 1 release; orgs can opt-in to enforcement via Admin console or API. Rollout plan: 1) deploy audit-enrichment to production 2) run migration report and notify customers 3) enable enforce flag for a small set of enterprise tenants 4) roll to broader population. Testing: unit tests for policy decision, integration tests against mock KMS, e2e tests simulating cross-region requests. Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked (ENG-4921) - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] Migration utility - [x] Console toggle UI wired - [x] Observability dashboards updated - [x] Product/Legal review sign-off
